name: tikspot
description: MikroTik hotspot container: FreeRADIUS + live captive portal + admin portal

scripts.build:local: docker buildx build --load --provenance=false --sbom=false --platform linux/amd64 -t tikspot:dev -f docker/Dockerfile . && node scripts/check-size.mjs tikspot:dev
